paragraphs.text: Stangg was a human warrior of Dominaria who lived at the time of the War with Phyrexia .

Stangg was a human warrior, who had a twin or the ability to conjure a double of himself. He appeared to be left-handed or ambidextrous. He was a dark skinned male, with a bald head, a red-haired beard, and was usually heavily armored. Although not much is known of Stangg's life, he was known to people of southwestern Jamuraa in 3335 AR, so he must have lived around that time or before.
Stangg's name was invoked in the idiom "Stangg’s Stones!" by 4077 AR .
Stangg ( Legends ) originally created a token with the unique creature type of Stangg Twin but it was given errata to be a human warrior named "Stangg Twin" during the Grand Creature Type Update .
